relations.statement: Within bounds max_items<=2 and max_arity<=2, valid deltas under mu1 are partitioned into isomorphism classes by bijections of items preserving the requirement pair; reading L has 6 deltas in 3 classes, reading F has 10 deltas in 5 classes.
relations.hypotheses: Declared bounds max_items 2 and max_arity 2; implemented isomorphism relation; exhaustive enumeration cross-checked against the unpruned space.

lemmas.statement: Reading F has exactly two classes beyond reading L at (2,2): links to and from the never-required genesis datum, non-isomorphic because the bijection must preserve the requirement pair.

near_misses.claim: The link to genesis and the link from genesis are isomorphic, so reading F has only 4 classes.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The isomorphism must preserve the requirement pair, which distinguishes the direction of the link relative to the genesis datum.

open_obligations: No existing declarations were found, so all references are proposed_new and need host-side Lean formalization.
The census replay and its cross-check against the unpruned space are not reproduced here.
mu2 minimality (two minimal deltas in one class for each reading) is not formalized.
